remarks: Discover comfort and convenience in this bright and welcoming first-floor apartment located in a well-maintained multi-family home in Stamford. This spacious unit offers a warm, inviting layout with generous natural light. Enjoy a thoughtfully designed living space featuring a comfortable living room, an updated kitchen with ample cabinetry, and well-sized bedrooms that provide the perfect retreat at the end of the day. The unit includes modern finishes throughout, along with the convenience of easy, ground-level access. Situated in a desirable Stamford neighborhood, you'll be moments away from local shops, dining, parks, public transportation, and major commuter routes-ideal for those seeking both residential charm and urban accessibility. Whether you're a professional, small family, or anyone looking for a cozy and convenient home, this first-floor rental delivers comfort, character, and unbeatable location. Second floor unit also available.
